build_task_with_define_task_decorator: use the define_task decorator to register a build_task function that constructs a PHYRE scene
create_scene_objects_with_C_add: add static bars and dynamic objects to a PHYRE scene using C.add with scale and position setters
set_object_positions_with_fluent_api: chain set_bottom set_left set_right set_angle and set_center calls to position scene objects
define_task_goal_with_update_task: call C.update_task with body1 body2 and SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING to define a task objective
access_scene_dimensions: read C.scene.width and C.scene.height to position objects relative to scene boundaries
